ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity-to-high intensity ratio; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region across the central fluke body; high-intensity pixel clusters located at the proximal leading edge near the central notch and at the extreme lower-left and lower-right margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximately 65-degree interior angle with a depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, low-frequency macro-serrations on the right lobe trailing edge; the left lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency, medium-amplitude peaks with a significant indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to sharply upturned, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of small, high-contrast circular pixel groups located on the upper-right quadrant of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of 4-5 parallel, diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the far left region of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged indentation/tissue loss on the upper-right trailing edge, approximately 75% of the distance from the notch to the right tip.
